parsed.notes:
WHAT YOU NEED sets required skills; NICE-TO-HAVE sets optional skills. Responsibilities and company descriptions do not independently establish requirements.
SFT is read literally as supervised fine-tuning. Statistical judgment maps to statistics; individual statistical concepts are not separate taxonomy entries.
HELM names an evaluation framework here, not the Helm deployment tool. The framework-list occurrence of verifiers is treated as a named framework.
The optional public-work example may ask for failure-analysis practice; flagged for review rather than silently omitting it.
Accounting and finance are excluded as domain knowledge. Ownership language alone does not establish seniority.
